title: Four ways to pass a Position
expectedStdout:
byValue:    modified a different object
  -> pos.qty = 100  (unchanged: the function changed its copy)
byConstRef: read pos itself, notional 250
byRef:      modified pos itself
  -> pos.qty = 0
byPtr:      modified pos itself
  -> pos.qty = 0
byPtr:      got nullptr, nothing to do
byConstRef: read a different object, notional 10
tryThis: Uncomment the last line: why is a temporary refused by `Position&` but accepted by `const Position&`?
Add `p.qty = 1;` inside `byConstRef` and read the error.
Call `byRef(pos)` with a `const Position cpos{ 1, 1.0 };` instead: which signatures still accept `cpos`?
